svg.title: XIX. The Beacon: Nixpkgs
svg.desc: XIX. The Beacon, upright. Nix. Nix Packages collection and NixOS. Artwork from scanned Gustave Doré Inferno engravings, first published in 1861.

g.desc: Gustave Doré, Inferno (1861), Onward he moved, I close his steps pursued. https://archive.org/details/dantesinferno00dantuoft; scan leaf 47. Public domain: nineteenth-century engravings; Doré died in 1883. The digitizing collection records NOT_IN_COPYRIGHT.
